svg.title: Week 13 - ECS Fargate and private RDS
svg.desc: An HTTP ALB spans two public subnets and routes to private FastAPI tasks. Tasks query private Multi-AZ MySQL over verified TLS. Private endpoints provide AWS service connectivity. CI and remote state are not deployed.
svg.text: Interface endpoints: ECR API, ECR Docker, Secrets Manager, Logs • one ENI per service in each AZ
Existing S3 gateway endpoint: ECR image layers • no NAT internet route
Execution role: image pulls, secret retrieval and logs. Task role: no application AWS API permissions.
HTTP-only lab endpoint • Local Terraform state • CI/CD deployment disabled
Placement shown across configured AZs; current task placement and RDS writer AZ must be verified from runtime metadata.
